name: First Sponsor Group Limited
summary: First Sponsor Group Limited, an investment holding company, invests in, develops, and sells residential and commercial properties primarily in the People's Republic of China and Europe. The company operates through Property Development, Property Investment, Property Financing, and Hotel Operations segments. It also provides interest bearing loans to vendor financing arrangements and subscription of debt securities. In addition, the company owns and operates hotels. First Sponsor Group Limited was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Singapore.
